name: Upgrade: Oil Slick
comment: From the server Lua shipped with the client (research/lmoxide-notes/client-survey/stats-and-minigames.md, stats_upgrade_lua.json): script 1725: a special cast puts 443624 on the caster for 1 s, which drops 443625 every 5 cs: a ground effect (effect 458873) of 4 pulses 0.5 s apart of 443626: radius 1, 504814 (the enemy's damage -10%). How often a puddle is dropped is assumed (every 0.25 s, not 5 cs).
